Root(params int[]) is not parameterless: a parameter array is a formal parameter (PDF p. 247 lines 36-38), and the edition uses 'parameterless' only for zero formal parameters, set against 'parameterized' (PDF p. 104 lines 14, 36-38; PDF p. 288 lines 45-46). The note that the default constructor is 'always of the form ... base()' (PDF p. 278 lines 56-57; PDF p. 279 lines 1-4) is informative (PDF p. 27 lines 16-20), and 17.10.1's implicit base() (PDF p. 276 lines 13-20, 27-28) selects a constructor but does not cancel 17.10.4's added error, which only the 7th edition replaces with 'as if ... base()' plus a unique-best rule (PDF p. 482; PDF p. 483 lines 3-4). The witness's explicit 'public Branch() : base() { }' compiles under 1st-ed 14.4.2.1's empty expanded form (PDF p. 149 lines 24-35), so the test isolates automatic-default status.
